releaseNotes:
• ✨ Smoother Typing: Fixed cursor jumps so typing amounts, accounts, and notes is smooth and effortless
• 💰 Payday Reminders: Customize your salary date & reminder time, or turn it off anytime
• ⚡ 1-Tap Salary Logging: Quickly record your income directly from your reminder notification
• 🔔 Notification Controls: Easily manage your update alerts and reminder preferences
• 🚀 Speed & Stability: Smoother animations and performance improvements throughout the app
